question: The Indian Navy conducted the fifth edition of the Indo-Indonesian Joint Maritime Drill ‘Samudra Shakti – 2025’ between 14 and 17 October 2025 at ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Visakhapatnam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Samudra Shakti** is a bilateral maritime exercise between the **Indian Navy** and the **Indonesian Navy**. It aims to enhance maritime cooperation and strengthen interoperability between the two navies.
 
• The fifth edition of this exercise, **Samudra Shakti – 2025**, was conducted from **14 to 17 October 2025** in **Visakhapatnam**, a key maritime hub on the eastern coast of India.
 
• The location, **Visakhapatnam**, holds strategic importance as it is home to the **Eastern Naval Command** of the Indian Navy and one of the largest natural harbors in India.
 
• The exercise focused on various naval operations, including **tactical maneuvers, surface warfare exercises, air defense operations**, and **search and rescue (SAR) missions**.
 
• The primary objective of the drill was to **enhance mutual understanding** and cooperation between the two navies in safeguarding the regional maritime domain
